correctness.rationale: The source ODE is algebraically transformed using p=x+z, q=z/p and exposure time. A strictly decreasing logistic q(s) and explicit integrating factor M(s) yield R(s)-1=[R0-F(s)]/M(s). The derivative F prime has at most one positive root, producing an exhaustive global first-contact basin split. Strictly negative F double-prime at equality gives the universal t^-2 coefficient. value.rationale: The initial-condition threshold gives the complete basin of selection in a published ecological evolutionary game where local stability and numerical phase portraits do not identify the arbitrary-data outcome. Its exact critical defector extinction power and universal amplitude reveal a nontrivial slowing not inferred from linear eigenvalues.
